pr_body: Fixes #97103. Maybe fixes other inconsistencies with other input methods.

issue_context.title: Zooming in 3D editor does not work with trackpad
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.dev2.official [97ef3c837]

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev2 - macOS 14.6.1 - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 (Apple8) - Apple M2 (8 Threads)

### Issue description

When using a trackpad to navigate in the 3D editor, zooming does not work. Orbitting and panning does work, though (with the default shortcuts).

### Steps to reproduce

- Use a trackpad
- Switch to the 3D editor
- Press Shift+Ctrl and try zooming by dragging up or down
- The pan gesture is used instead of zoom

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A

review_comments: Pan gesture has no mouse button and shortcuts can be empty (e.g., orbit), so `_get_nav_mode_from_shortcut_check` can't be used here.
